Building scalable systems that redefine what’s possible in SaaS—this is where I thrive. Over 13 years, I’ve architected backend infrastructures that scale from 10k to 10M users, blending Go, Kubernetes, and AWS into seamless, high-performance engines. At NexaCorp, I lead a team of 8 engineers, owning the full stack from API design to CI/CD pipelines, ensuring our SaaS platform outperforms competitors in reliability and speed.  

My career is defined by measurable impact: slashing deployment times by 40% via custom CI/CD pipelines, building a monitoring system that cut downtime by 70%, and architecting a multi-region AWS setup that handled 500M+ requests monthly. I mentor others in Go, PostgreSQL, and Terraform, turning junior engineers into rockstars.  

Looking ahead, I’m hunting for a role where I can shape the future of distributed systems—whether it’s pioneering real-time data processing or integrating AI/ML into backend workflows. Let’s build something that lasts.
